fields.contract: BatchExtensions exposes one Add extension family for composing a Batch from a Query contract. A ShardBatch<TResult> or DatabaseBatch<TResult> receiver selects the result shape: a comparable scalar record, a sequence of records (IList<TRecord> or List<TRecord>), a virtual compound key or key sequence (ShardKey<...>, IList<ShardKey<...>>, or List<ShardKey<...>>) with optional child identity and optional shard-identifier column, or a model produced by a supplied QueryResultModelHandler. Every overload adds one matching BatchStep<TResult> operation via the receiver's generically-typed Add(BatchStep<TResult>) (which appends to batch.Steps) and returns the original receiver. Overloads either accept an explicit DbParameterCollection or use an empty ParameterCollection; record and key type arguments are constrained to IComparable, and model type arguments have a public parameterless constructor (where TModel : new()). Three structural conventions hold within the family: (1) when a model step needs no caller-supplied argument, the overload constructs ModelStep<object?, TModel> with a QueryResultModelHandler<object?, TModel> and passes null as optionalArgument; (2) among the data-column overloads, the IList<TRecord> and List<TRecord> list-result forms require an explicit DbParameterCollection, while the TRecord scalar form offers both a parameterized overload and a parameterless overload that supplies an empty ParameterCollection; (3) the key-sequence and data-column list result shapes are provided for both IList<...> and List<...> batch receivers via dedicated step types (KeyListStep<TRecord> / KeyListOfListStep<TRecord>, ChildListStep<TRecord, TChild> / ChildListOfListStep<TRecord, TChild>, and ListStep<TRecord> / ListOfListStep<TRecord>) backed by shared reader helpers.
fields.name: BatchExtensions Add overload family

sources.label: ShardKey list family duplicated across IList<> and List<> receivers; List<> forms add via an explicit (IList) cast
Plain data-column List<TRecord> overloads also add via an explicit (IList) cast
BatchBase<TResult> implements only ICollection and IEnumerable<BatchStep<TResult>>, not IList
ShardBatch<TResult> derives from BatchBase<TResult> and adds no IList implementation
DatabaseBatch<TResult> derives from BatchBase<TResult> and adds no IList implementation
